definitions.explanation: Informal talk about other people's private affairs, often unverified or speculative in nature.

examples.japanese: {噂話|うわさばなし}に{花|はな}が{咲|さ}いた。
examples.english: We got carried away with gossip.

examples.japanese: {噂話|うわさばなし}を{信|しん}じるな。
{近所|きんじょ}の{噂話|うわさばなし}ばかりしている。
examples.english: They're always gossiping about the neighbors.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{噂|うわさ} (rumor) + {話|ばなし} (talk, story) - talk consisting of rumors.

USAGE:
Generally has negative connotations in Japanese, implying:
・Talking behind someone's back
・Spreading unverified information
・Being nosy about others' affairs

COLLOCATIONS:
・{噂話|うわさばなし}をする - to gossip
・{噂話|うわさばなし}に{花|はな}が{咲|さ}く - to get carried away with gossip
・{噂話|うわさばなし}を{広|ひろ}める - to spread gossip

RELATED:
・{井戸端会議|いどばたかいぎ} - neighborhood gossip (lit. 'well-side meeting')
・{陰口|かげぐち} - talking behind someone's back
